description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Saab, Inc. is hiring an Associate Software Engineer to contribute to product development and project execution. The role supports Saab’s work in defense and security technology and requires software and systems engineering capabilities.
Associate Software Engineer contributing to product development and project execution

Responsibilities:
• Join a dynamic team of dedicated, enthusiastic employees with an established reputation for integrity, quality, excellence, and teamwork
• Advance your career at Saab Inc. while making significant contributions to a safer society
• Play a critical role in successfully developing products and executing projects to achieve Saab’s vision

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree (or higher) in computer science, software engineering or related discipline
• 1+ years of related experience required
• C/C++ programming experience
• Object-Oriented Analysis and Design skills, preferably utilizing UML
• Experience working with Unix-based systems (Linux)
• Ability to systematically evaluate data
• Must be able to work in a dynamic team environment
• Must be a U.S. citizen
• Applicants selected may be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information

Preferred:
• Relational Database experience (SQL)
• Familiarity with software version control systems (e.g. Subversion)
• Good written and verbal communication skills
